text:
alex: Quick coordination Q — we're preparing a small rollout that changes the response envelope for /v1/generate (minor schema tweak). How does that interact with model pinning and the Accept-Schema header? Do clients that set Accept-Model implicitly get the old envelope or the new one?

mina: short: Accept-Model pins the model variant only. Schema negotiation is separate — Accept-Schema (or default server schema) controls envelope. so pins != schema version. :thumbsup:

jorge: follow-up: if we flip default schema server-side, will pinned clients break? i.e., they pin model but don't send Accept-Schema.

mina: they'll get whatever the default schema for that model runtime is. if we change default envelope without a grace period, yes some integrations could break. that's why we add a deprecation window and fallback mapping.

alex: OK. propose: for this change we do a 14-day deprecation window where both envelopes are served when Accept-Schema is missing. new default after 14d. thoughts?

sam: sounds reasonable. let's also add a runtime flag so Dedicated/private customers can opt into new schema immediately — avoid surprises for enterprise.

mina: +1. ops checklist: 
- patch runtime to support dual-envelope based on header absent
- metric: schema_mismatch_count 
- telemetry: sample 0.1% of old-envelope responses with new-schema transformations for verification

jorge: can we make the dual-envelope behaviour opt-in per route? e.g. /v1/chat keep old for longer?

mina: yes, routing config supports route-level schema overrides. i'll add a config PR.

alex: communication plan: 
- Friday: blog+console banner saying "schema v2 rolling out, 14-day grace; send Accept-Schema to lock"
- Email to top 50 integrators who hit /v1/generate most
- Post in #customer-success to prep CS playbook

sam: ping UX/docs for examples: show curl + headers: 
```
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Accept-Model: redwood/gpt-l6" \
  -H "Accept-Schema: schema.v2"
```

alex: one more: what about SDK auto-pin behaviour? our SDK currently auto-pins when Accept-Model is omitted (it chooses runtime default). if we change default schema, older SDK versions might break.

mina: recommended: SDKs should start sending explicit Accept-Schema once they bump parser logic. but to avoid breakage, runtime will honor an SDK-compat header `X-SDK-Compat` to keep old-schema for known old SDK versions during the window. we'll publish a compatibility matrix.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: schema-rollout/dual-envelope v1.2 -> staging at 2025-08-12 02:00 UTC, canary 2025-08-13 08:00 UTC, prod 2025-08-20 03:00 UTC.

alex: thanks all — action items: mina to open config + metrics PR, sam to draft customer banner, jorge to list endpoints needing extended grace. I'll sync with PM on the email list. :eyes:

mina: PR #4127 opened with route override and metric hooks.

jorge: posted initial endpoint list in the doc, will add per-route timelines by EOD.

sam: banner draft in docs PR #88, tagging @marketing for review.

alex: perfect. we'll re-check next week in async update. :rocket:
